entries.source: You need to ready alchemist gems in your quiver.
entries.target: 你需要在箭袋中装填炼金宝石。

entries.source: A beautiful woman, clad in shining plate armour. Power radiates from her.
entries.target: 一位身披闪亮板甲的美女。力量从她身上散发出来。

entries.source:
Green-skinned and ugly, this massive humanoid glares at you, clenching wart-covered green fists.
He looks hurt.
entries.target:
绿皮丑陋，这只巨大的人形生物正盯着你，握紧了满是肉瘤的绿色拳头。
他看起来受伤了。

entries.source:
Projects a bolt of pure blight, doing %0.2f blight damage.
		This spell has an improved critical strike chance of +%0.2f%%.
		The damage will increase with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
向目标发射一枚纯粹的枯萎弹，造成 %0.2f 枯萎伤害。
		此技能的暴击率增加 +%0.2f%%。
		伤害受法术强度加成。

entries.source: Wickedly sharp and still freezing cold.
entries.target: 异乎寻常的锋利且散发着阵阵寒气。

entries.source: You cannot take out more points!
Space around you starts to dissolve...
entries.target: 你周围的空间开始消解...

entries.source: The timeline is too fractured to do this now.
entries.target: 目前的时间线过于破碎。

entries.source: Wound the target dealing #RED#%d#LAST# physical damage across 5 turns and reducing healing by %d%%
entries.target: 使目标流血，在5回合内造成#RED#%d#LAST#物理伤害，并降低目标治疗系数%d%%
#LIGHT_BLUE# * +4 魔法，+0 意志，+0 灵巧

entries.source: blink to a nearby random location (rad %d)
entries.target: 随机传送至附近的某个位置（半径 %d）

entries.source: Green eyes stare out from behind strands of long, golden hair, which falls down in waves over smooth, pale skin. Your eyes are drawn to the bare flesh, but as they look further they see dark scales stretching out into a long serpent's tail. You look up as she moves, her hair parting to reveal a slim and beautiful face with high cheekbones and full lips. Yet for all the allure of this wondrous creature the terror of the serpentine tail sends shivers down your spine.
entries.target: 绿色的眼睛后面是披落在白皙肩膀的金发。你的眼睛被裸露的肌肤所吸引，但是当你往下看时，你会发现黑色的长蛇尾巴。当她移动时你看向她的脸部，在金发之下是红润而美丽的脸庞，有着高颧骨和丰满的嘴唇。虽然从各方面看来，她都很完美，但是仍掩饰不住你眼皮底下的蛇尾巴带来的恐怖。

entries.source: It still drips venom and crackles with magical energy.
entries.target: 它仍滴着毒液，魔法能量在上面噼啪作响。

entries.source: Sook's Runes and other Harmless Contraptions
A length of troll intestines. Fortunately, the troll appears to have eaten nothing in some time.
entries.target: 一截巨魔肠子。幸运的是，这只巨魔似乎已经有一段时间没吃东西了。

entries.source: A messily scrawled pile of loose papers.
entries.target: 一堆乱涂乱画的散乱文件。
